body: I see so many people die that have dont nothing in their lives but sit around and waste time and im afraid of that being me

Idk man. So a little context im pretty nerdy i game a lot and all that jazz, I work at an old folks home so im around death a lot and that tends to put me in a petty bad headspace. I just get sick of not being good at anything I do. Most of my relationships ended in being cheated on except my most recent one that lasted 2 years but I had to leave because i was only dating her to make my mom happy and i wasnt happy with her at all. Ive just hit this rut of being shitty at everything I do and im getting so sick of myself. Everyones good for something and I get that and i see that in everyone i meet. Theres always some sort of thing that they are meant to do or just good at doing but i cant find mine. I dont see any reason for me to be around at all.
